photo.description: Brahu temple at Trowulan archaeological site, East Java. The tall red bricks temple is dated from Majapahit period circa 13th to 15th century.

photo.description: Segaran pool, 375 m x 175 m rectangular water reservoir dated from 14th century Majapahit era, Trowulan Archaeological Park, East java, Indonesia.
